description: Access Adafruit IO feeds and IoT data. Use feed information and observations to review IoT data and investigate device-related questions. Organize results by feed identifier and time, then compare them with device operating records. Consider sampling intervals, missing observations, and timestamps before interpreting an anomaly. A single observation should not be treated as a complete description of a device’s operating state.
description_cn: 连接 Adafruit IO，查询数据流和物联网数据。适合整理物联网数据流的背景和观测结果，辅助设备数据查看与问题排查。可按数据流标识和时间顺序对返回信息进行核对，再与设备运行记录关联。判断异常时应关注数据采样间隔、缺失记录和时间戳，避免仅凭一条观测值推断设备状态。
